rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: ORAvolmon
Exhibition name: Shirley's Bouquet
rows.Origin:
Bred by Pierre Orard (France, before 2015).
Introduced in United States by Texas Rose Ventures in 2015 as 'Shirley's Bouquet'.
rows.Bloom: White, blush edges. [White blend or white.] Moderate, strong fragrance. Average diameter 3.25". Medium to large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, globular bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, upright. Medium, matte, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 31" to 47" (80 to 120cm). Width: 18" to 20" (45 to 50cm).
rows.Parentage:
Moonstone ™ (Hybrid Tea, Carruth 1998) ×
Vol de Nuit (hybrid tea, Delbard, 1970)
rows.Notes: We have presumed the pollen parent was the 1970 'Vol de Nuit' and not the 2010 rose.

colour: White, blush edges. [White blend or white.]
